skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the role of financial audit reports in influencing decisions.
Identify the steps in a risk-based financial audit process.
Explain the relationship between audit evidence requirements and audit objectives in the financial audit process.
Identify the planning steps for audits in relation to the execution of the financial audit process.
Combine audit techniques with internal control review to design procedures for collecting audit evidence according to specific audit objectives in financial auditing.
Apply sampling methods to perform audit procedures according to specific audit objectives.
Determine the type of audit report in the financial audit process.
Identify factors affecting the quality of financial audit reports and the effectiveness of risk management and internal controls processes.
Apply comprehensive audit knowledge to solve problems during the financial audit process.
Develop solutions to improve the effectiveness of internal control and risk management processes in the audited entity, particularly internal controls related to financial reporting.
Identify advantages and challenges when applying audit standards in the audit planning process for clients.
Determine conditions for applying each audit method in designing and performing an audit procedure according to specific audit objectives.
Apply results of significance level evaluation in audit planning for financial statements.
Apply audit techniques in targeted testing to form different audit procedures.
Integrate internal control review into each step of audit planning and audit procedure design.
Apply various sampling techniques consistently in performing audit procedures to test control activities, accounts, disclosures, and data sources.
Determine the appropriate audit opinion type based on specific evidence conditions.
Prepare key contents of an audit report based on provided information about a client's financial statement audit.

Comply with laws, regulations, ethical standards, and specific guidelines when planning, designing, and performing audits according to specific audit objectives while fulfilling specific client financial statement audit contracts.
